metadata.source: Research compilation — Wikidata Q-IDs verified via wikidata.org API
metadata.description: Classic historical fiction works — major films and TV series connecting to existing figures in the graph. Work-heavy batch to increase entity count and relationship density.

works.title: The Imitation Game
works.creator: Morten Tyldum
works.description: Biographical drama about mathematician Alan Turing's pivotal role in cracking the Enigma code during World War II and his subsequent persecution for homosexuality

works.title: The Pianist
works.creator: Roman Polanski
works.description: True story of pianist Wladyslaw Szpilman's survival of the Warsaw Ghetto, winner of the Palme d'Or and three Academy Awards

works.title: Downfall
works.creator: Oliver Hirschbiegel
works.description: Harrowing depiction of Hitler's final days in his Berlin bunker as the Soviet army closes in, based on the memoirs of his secretary Traudl Junge

works.title: Troy
works.creator: Wolfgang Petersen
works.description: Retelling of the Trojan War focusing on the rivalry between Achilles and Hector, stripping the myth of its gods to tell a human drama of love and war

works.title: Cleopatra (1963)
works.creator: Joseph L. Mankiewicz
works.description: Lavish epic starring Elizabeth Taylor as the Egyptian queen, depicting her relationships with Julius Caesar and Mark Antony

works.title: The English Patient
works.creator: Anthony Minghella
works.description: Sweeping romantic drama about a dying man's memories of a passionate affair in pre-war North Africa, winner of nine Academy Awards

works.title: The Pillars of the Earth
works.creator: Sergio Mimica-Gezzan
works.description: Television adaptation of Ken Follett's epic novel about the building of a cathedral in 12th-century England against the backdrop of the Anarchy

works.title: Medici: Masters of Florence
works.creator: Frank Spotnitz
works.description: Period drama chronicling the rise of the Medici family as the bankers of Florence, their political intrigues, and their patronage of the Renaissance

works.title: Peaky Blinders
works.creator: Steven Knight
works.description: Gangster family drama set in post-WWI Birmingham, following the Shelby crime family's rise to power in the industrial underworld

works.title: The Last Kingdom
works.creator: Stephen Butchard
works.description: Historical drama following a Saxon nobleman raised by Vikings who must navigate the conflict between Danes and Saxons as Alfred the Great unifies England

works.title: Downton Abbey
works.creator: Julian Fellowes
works.description: British period drama depicting the lives of the aristocratic Crawley family and their servants, set against the backdrop of early 20th-century England

works.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
works.creator: Martin Scorsese
works.description: Epic crime drama about the systematic murders of Osage Nation members for their oil wealth in 1920s Oklahoma, and the birth of the FBI

works.creator: Sam Mendes
works.description: War film shot to appear as a single continuous take, following two British soldiers on a desperate mission across No Man's Land

works.title: All Quiet on the Western Front (novel)
works.creator: Erich Maria Remarque
works.description: Devastating anti-war novel about a young German soldier's experience in the trenches of World War I, one of the most influential war novels ever written

works.title: Gallipoli
works.creator: Peter Weir
works.description: Australian film following two young sprinters who enlist and fight in the disastrous Gallipoli Campaign of 1915

works.title: War Horse
works.creator: Steven Spielberg
works.description: A young man searches for his beloved horse who has been sold to the cavalry during World War I

works.title: Lawrence of Arabia
works.creator: David Lean
works.description: Epic biographical film following T. E. Lawrence's role in the Arab Revolt during WWI, widely considered one of the greatest films ever made

works.title: Apocalypto
works.creator: Mel Gibson
works.description: Action epic set in the declining Maya civilization, following a young man captured for human sacrifice who must escape to save his family

works.title: The Motorcycle Diaries
works.creator: Walter Salles
works.description: Road film based on Che Guevara's journals of his 1952 motorcycle journey across South America

works.title: Frida
works.creator: Julie Taymor
works.description: Biographical film starring Salma Hayek as Frida Kahlo, depicting her art, politics, and passionate marriage to Diego Rivera

works.title: Aguirre, the Wrath of God
works.creator: Werner Herzog
works.description: A Spanish expedition descends into madness as the megalomaniac Aguirre leads a doomed search for El Dorado down the Amazon
